title: Farewell to the Fluid Science Laboratory after 18 years in orbit
Time to wake up MetOp-SG-B1 weather satellite
summary: Following a short period in storage after arriving at Europe’s Spaceport in French Guiana, the MetOp Second Generation-B1 satellite has been transferred to a cleanroom and removed from its transport container. The team is now preparing to reactivate this ‘sleeping beauty, and begin the final checks and preparations ahead of its launch, planned towards the end of the year.
